messages:
max: FYI ran a focused perf sweep: FlashAttention v1/v2, paged-attn (4k page), fused-attn optimized kernels. Compared prefill vs continuous decode for small-batch (1-4) and medium (8-32). Uploading traces.

max: upload: https://internal.s3/redwood/bench/1782546789/trace.tar.gz :spiral_notepad: 

infra-bot: New artifact uploaded by max: trace.tar.gz

sara: nice. quick summary? numbers?

max: TL;DR: prefill high-seq workloads -> FA-v2 edges out fused by ~6-8% throughput and uses 12% less memory. For decode small-batch (1-2) fused-attn with kernel fallback wins latency due to fewer kernel launches. Paged-attn best when seq>6k or kv-cache fragmentation high.

raj: can you paste minimal table? helps ops triage.

max: ```
model: 6B, seq_prefill=2048, decode_len=256
FA-v1: prefill 420ms/batch(32) (avg token 13.1ms), decode(1) 22.3ms/token
FA-v2: prefill 386ms/batch(32) (11.9ms/token), decode(1) 20.8ms/token
fused-attn: prefill 410ms/batch(32) (12.8ms/token), decode(1) 18.5ms/token
paged-attn(4k): prefill 470ms/batch(32), decode(1) 21.7ms/token
``` 

jessica: interesting fused is better on small decode. was caching behavior identical across runs? KV cache fragmentation? 

max: yes same seed but noticed more page splits for prefill with paged-attn on mixed seq inputs -> extra memcpy. KV cache fragmentation seems to hurt paged-attn perf on prefill.

sam: did you try continuous-batching changes? last week we changed the decode batcher heuristics.

max: ran with both: continuous batching enabled drop-in gives 15-25% latency win for decode across FA variants for multi-client microbatches. But for single-client single-token steady throughput, fused-attn still wins due to launch coalescing.

sara: any perf regression vs baseline on 8-bit quantized kernels?

max: FA-v2 quantized path currently regressed ~3% for prefill vs float16, investigating kernel reorder that regresses GEMM perf. creating a ticket.

max: filed https://redwood/issue/RT-4123 'FA-v2 q8 prefill gemm regression' with traces.

raj: For rollout, recommendation?

jessica: canary fused-attn for decode paths on hosted, keep FA-v2 for prefill-heavy routes. Add metric to console: 'small_batch_decode_p95' and 'paged_page_splits/sec'.

sam: i'll add the metrics + canary policy. also add automatic fallback if p95>50ms.

infra-bot: Deploy plan created by sam: canary fused-decode -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% (with rollback on p95 > 55ms)

max: I'll follow up with microprofiler traces for kernel launch counts and CUDA occupancy. Thanks all :thumbsup:
